summary: Comprehensive testing of MyGenePortal genomics platform. Backend: 24/24 API tests passed. Frontend: All major flows working - tests catalog loads 12 tests from backend, NABL & CAP text displays correctly everywhere, WhatsApp button works, coupon verification functions correctly (minor UI bug in display). Lead creation, order creation, and sample tracking all operational.

ui_bugs.issue: Coupon success message displays '1000% off' instead of '5% off' - the code stores discount_amount (₹1000) but displays it as a percentage. Line 276 and 289 show appliedCoupon.discount as percentage when it's actually the discount amount in rupees
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Store the actual percentage from coupon data or calculate it. The backend returns discount_type='percentage' - add a separate field for the percentage value

action_items: Fix Cart.jsx coupon display: appliedCoupon.discount shows the discount amount (1000) but is displayed as percentage ('1000% off'). Should either store actual percentage or change display text
critical_code_review_comments: Cart.jsx line 29-33: appliedCoupon.discount stores result.discount_amount (₹ value) but UI on lines 276 and 289 displays it as percentage
Code quality is good overall - proper use of React hooks, API service layer, error handling

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all major features working, one minor UI display bug)

seed_data_creation: Data seeded via POST /api/seed-data endpoint - 12 tests, 3 coupons (MYGENE5, MYGENE10, FIRSTORDER), 3 blog posts, 6 health categories, 4 testimonials
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs working. Tests created in /app/backend/tests/test_mygeneportal_api.py can be rerun with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://mygene-launch.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Minor UI bug in Cart.jsx coupon display that should be fixed.
